system.description:
Master of hellfire and unbreakable contracts. More dangerous to cross than to serve.

  • Patron boon: Once a day, seal a binding oath of up to 10 words; whoever breaks a deal made under it has Disadvantage on its next three Charisma checks and bears a brand only you can see.

Allegiance: Lawful Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Mephistopheles in the World of Arneyan wiki.
